$comment: The AI tools your staff already use. Register each one, then screen the actions bound for it against its data policy. Shape only — real tools are added via `a2a ai-tools add`; the per-tool policy (blockDataClasses/reviewDataClasses) is set in the dashboard AI-tools panel. Data classes the gate detects: secret, pci, pii, confidential, bulk-export. An UNREGISTERED tool is held for review (shadow AI). A prompt is bound to a tool with `a2a eval "…" --tool ChatGPT`.
